Mark this source-level specificity as over-annotated while retaining the positive integrin reorganization, ligand context, adhesion and migration findings. This is not a claim that altered matrix could never influence integrin expression.

The complete original abstract directly reports PDGF association with several collagen types including type V and their constituent chains, with collagen-bound growth factor retaining activity in cell assays. Retain the binding context. The reported affinity range pools tested collagens; exact preparation species and a COL5A1-specific value are not established from the available abstract.

Actual original human EDS examinations and separate mouse Col5a1-haploinsufficiency Methods/Results show altered corneal/lid architecture and increased fibril diameter with reduced stromal collagen, while cylindrical fibrils remain regularly packed in organized lamellae. Retain the structural contribution to eye morphology. Human COL5A1 and COL5A2 cases are distinguished, and this does not require COL5A1 to be a phototransduction protein or assign a direct activity to every clinical variant.

The PAINT skeletal-morphogenesis placement is compatible with collagen-mediated tissue architecture and current resolved descendant evidence. Retain this contextual developmental role outside the core molecular function. The historical IBD node was not reconstructed; differing collagen family roles and a short donor list alone do not demonstrate a placement error.

Recovered original human fibroblast experiments concern organization of collagen and fibronectin networks and their restoration by purified collagen treatment. The broader fiber-organization term therefore captures performed matrix work beyond a collagen-only fibril-size endpoint. Retain it without forcing a narrower replacement or making every integrin response a direct binding assay.

term.label: negative regulation of endodermal cell differentiation

decision_summaries.reason: Actual human embryonic-stem-cell experiments expose cells to printed extracellular-matrix combinations under Wnt/Activin differentiation conditions. Factorial analysis associates inclusion of collagen V with reduced definitive-endoderm output measured by SOX17; this is a controlled extracellular cue experiment, not merely COL5A1 marker expression. Retain the contextual effect without proposing a universal endogenous developmental mechanism, a receptor or equal activity of all alpha1(V) products.

The human alpha1(V) N-propeptide binds pepsinized type I and VI collagens in SPR experiments, and selected collagen domains are retested by controlled co-immunoprecipitation. Separate solid-phase assays implicate this N-propeptide in the native collagen V–VI interaction. This directly supports collagen binding at the tested domain/preparation scope, without assigning equal affinity to both precursor splice products, a new matrix-bridging process or an autonomous adaptor mechanism. Current GO:0005518 has no ancestor/descendant overlap with the source or effective MF terms; its adhesion-specific and collagen-V-ligand children do not describe these assays.
